description: Cross-surface Robot and MCP control-plane response matrix. Rows bind representative stable envelopes to checked-in fixtures, schemas, docs, and focused RCH proof lanes.

dynamic_scrub_rules.reason: Command runtime varies across local and RCH workers.
Robot and MCP envelopes stamp wall-clock time.
Checkpoint list and rollback rows are time ordered.
Session identifiers can be generated per test workspace.
Remote proof workers are assigned dynamically.
Workspace and database paths differ by machine and temp directory.
Path arrays inherit host-specific workspace roots.

rows.proof_command: rch exec -- env CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/ft-bsfb9-5-cli-goldens cargo test -p frankenterm --test cli_golden_artifacts robot_state_toon_local_single_pane_matches_golden -- --nocapture
rows.notes: Pins the stable TOON Robot success envelope for pane discovery.
